name: web-violet-meeting-assistant-site-on-laptop-with-floating-glass-panels
title: Violet Meeting Assistant Site with Glass Panels
whatItIs: A violet gradient cover with a giant white 'Meeting Assistant' title partly behind a dark laptop that shows a dark AI meeting site, with a translucent site panel floating in front, a calendar panel and Download App card at the right, an app icon tile at the top right and a Website Design pill.
whatItMeans: Layers of floating glass panels around a dark laptop explode the site into parts and give depth to a dark UI.
techniques: Floating translucent panels in front of the device
Giant title partly hidden behind the laptop
App icon tile as a brand stamp
Dark UI with lit calendar cards

vocabulary.definition: A UI panel pulled out of the screen and floated in front.
A scene with elements at several depths.
A small icon tile signing the composition.
